audit.note: exposure_exact re-solves the realized PSPS recourse with HiGHS at a 1e-6 relative MIP gap. The grid's eval_cost came from Gurobi at its default 1e-4 relative gap, so small differences, and different shutoff counts at the same exposure, are expected.

budget_fill.note: Sectionalization has no cost in the model besides its budget and only adds     PSPS options, so a plan that leaves budget unused can be completed for free     (``model.fill_sectionalization``, run by ``ingest``: circuits in order of the     predicted exposure ``p_i * mu_i``, then the realized PSPS response re-solved).

ranking_baselines.note: Fill the whole sectionalization budget by a predicted ranking, no fast-trip, same test-year PSPS response.

fast_trip_threshold.note: One fast-trip setting removes ``E`` of a circuit's exposure for ``G`` units of     SAIFI; one PSPS shutoff removes all of it for ``delta`` units, but only where     and when it is used. The ratio ``E / (G / delta)`` is fast-trip's exposure     removed per unit of reliability relative to a shutoff.
